guidance.bestFor: The minimal anatomy: an outline Button trigger and a card holding a heading over one muted line

whenNotToUse.when: A callout that leads with an icon beside its title

guidance.bestFor: A grid of outline triggers, one per placement, each opening its card on the side its label names
agentNotes: `inline-start` and `inline-end` are base twin values of `side` that follow text direction; radix takes top, right, bottom or left only

guidance.bestFor: A person's avatar, name and handle as the trigger, opening a larger photo with role and join date
agentNotes: `HoverCardTrigger` renders as a plain `div` here, which is not focusable, so keyboard users never open the card; make it a profile link
Name, handle and the Unsplash photo URL are typed twice, in the trigger and in `HoverCardContent`; feed both from one user object

whenNotToUse.when: An avatar that opens a list of account actions on click

guidance.bestFor: A feature callout on an outline button, an amber bolt icon beside a short title and a muted blurb

whenNotToUse.when: A plain heading over one line of copy with no icon

name: c-hover-card-5
title: Hover card with an image and text content.
label: Image & Text
description: Hover card with an image and text content.

guidance.bestFor: An edge to edge 16:9 picture across the top of a 320px wide card, captioned by a title and one line
agentNotes: The `img` loads a random grayscale picsum.photos image with alt Card Image; swap in your preview and a real description

whenNotToUse.when: An image tile with its caption that stays on the page at all times

guidance.bestFor: A trigger set in the body of an open Dialog, below its title and description, for previews inside a modal

name: c-hover-card-7
title: Timestamp hover card with active relative time
label: Live Timestamp
description: Timestamp hover card with active relative time

guidance.bestFor: A dashed underline relative time inside a sentence, opening the exact deploy time over a live clock that ticks each second
agentNotes: `referenceTime` is always 2 hours before `now`; set it from your real deploy timestamp
The UTC row runs `referenceTime` through date-fns `format`, which prints local time; convert it to UTC or relabel that row

whenNotToUse.when: The same timestamp detail opened with a tap on a touch screen

name: c-hover-card-8
title: Hover card with paginated release notes
label: Release Notes
description: Hover card with paginated release notes

guidance.bestFor: A dashed What's new link opening release entries stepped through with arrow buttons and a dot per entry
agentNotes: `releases` holds 4 sample versions with dates, tags and copy; replace it with your own changelog entries
